blocks.en: As the example above indicates, we will need to assume that the boundary has some smoothness properties in order to get a boundary regularity result (also called a global regularity result). In order to emphasize the most important techniques in the proof (breaking up the domain using a partition of unity and mapping the pieces containing portions of the boundary to a half-space) we will give the proof only for second-order scalar equations and in the proof we will ignore lower-order terms.
blocks.zh: 如上例所示, 为得到边界正则性结果 (也称为整体正则性结果), 需要假设边界具有某些光滑性. 为突出证明中最重要的技巧 (利用单位分解将区域分块, 并将含有部分边界的块映到半空间), 只对二阶标量方程给出证明, 且在证明中忽略低阶项.

blocks.en: The proof of this result is rather long and involved, so we will break it up by proving a number of preliminary lemmas. One of our basic techniques is to decompose the domain into pieces using a partition of unity and ``flattening out\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ any portion of the boundary. As we see in our first lemma (which is essentially a version of the main result in the case where the boundary is already flat) a flat boundary allows us to use difference quotients to our advantage.
blocks.zh: 这个结果的证明较长且复杂, 因此将通过证明若干预备引理把它分开. 一个基本技巧是用单位分解将区域分块, 并将每一部分边界 ``展平\textquotesingle\textquotesingle. 正如第一个引理所示 (它实质上是边界已经平坦时主要结果的一个版本), 平坦边界使得差商技巧得以有效使用.
